record_title: Exact entropy minimizer and normalization obstruction for ELCD interface states
provenance: Source-specific analysis of the entropy-based local characteristic decomposition in arXiv:2609.19838v1, with exact convex minimization and entropy-pair normalization analysis.
limitations: The result corrects the stated continuous rectangle-minimization interpretation and identifies normalization dependence of the corner selector. It does not show that the published ELCD computations fail, nor that the continuous minimizer or a relative-entropy variant improves accuracy or stability.
